name: logPHIReadAccess
shortDescription: Records an audit log entry whenever a user accesses Protected Health Information (PHI).
description:
Overview

This function records a detailed audit log entry every time a user (patient, doctor, or admin) accesses Protected Health Information (PHI) from a MedicalRecord. This is crucial for compliance and security auditing.

Intended use

Called by the UI or other access points whenever PHI is viewed. Parameters include the medicalRecordId being accessed and the userId performing the access.

Logic

  1. Validate the medicalRecordId and the context of the access.
  2. Retrieve the MedicalRecord using ctx.data.get to confirm its existence and type.
  3. Create an audit log entry using ctx.audit.log with action 'PHI_READ_ACCESS', resourceType 'MedicalRecord', and resourceId of the accessed record.
  4. Include contextual information such as the user's role, the specific PHI fields accessed (if granularly tracked), and the timestamp.
  5. Return a success status.

Entities

  • MedicalRecord
  • AuditLog
